jobs.title: (Senior) Product Manager - Member Management (m/f/d)
jobs.description: About us Pliant is a modular B2B payments platform that combines commercial card issuing, payment accounts, FX, and spend management in one system - adapting to existing setups rather than requiring customers to replace them. Businesses across industries such as travel, e-commerce, and insurance use Pliant to manage complex payment workflows with cards, backed by credit lines Pliant underwrites itself. Fintechs and software platforms embed Pliant's payment infrastructure into their own products, from API-based Cards-as-a-Service to fully white-label solutions. Banks use Pliant's Card & Spend OS, the customer-facing interface, on their own infrastructure to run card programs. Founded in 2020 and headquartered in Berlin, Pliant serves 5,000+ businesses and 40+ partners across Europe and the United States. A principal member of Visa and Mastercard, Pliant issues commercial cards in 13 currencies across 32 countries - under its own European e-money license and with licensed partners in the UK and US. Learn more at www.getpliant.com About the role Member Management is the trust layer of Pliant. The team owns identity, authentication, access and permissions, the full member lifecycle, and the multi-region tenant structure underneath it all. As Pliant moves up-market and works with banks and larger partners, this area becomes increasingly important: security reviews and vendor assessments depend heavily on how well we handle identity and access. As (Senior) Product Manager - Member Management (m/f/d), you will own how members - and increasingly AI agents - access Pliant. Your scope covers authentication (passkeys, eIDs, enterprise IDPs, SSO), the permissions model, the joiner-mover-leaver lifecycle, and multi-tenant, multi-region identity for partners and banks. The main challenge is combining bank-grade security with an access experience that stays simple for members. This is a hands-on, platform-heavy role for someone who enjoys structuring ambiguous problems, working closely with engineers on identity topics, and building capabilities that other teams at Pliant rely on. jobs.title: Sr Product Manager - FMS
jobs.description: Job Description Summary The Connected Aircraft Navigation Systems Sr. Product Manager will lead the Flight Management Systems (FMS) product line within our Connected Aircraft portfolio. In this role, you will work cross-functionally with sales, engineering, contracts, finance, marketing, and program management to define and execute product strategy, shape investment plans, capture customer needs, build differentiated solutions, and drive business growth. You will be responsible for developing product roadmaps, supporting new business opportunities, managing product development efforts, and delivering financial results for your product line. This role requires both strategic thinking and strong execution, with a focus on aligning customer needs, technology development, and business priorities. You will also partner closely with other product managers across the Connected Aircraft portfolio, helping balance priorities as proposal and program activity shifts across the team. One of the immediate priorities for this role will be supporting the Boeing 737 FMS update program. Note: The preferred location for this role is at the Grand Rapids, Michigan or Clearwater, FL, but remote work within the United States may be considered based on candidate qualifications. Job Description Key Responsibilities: • Develop, maintain, and update product line strategies and technology roadmaps to support business growth and long-term market competitiveness • Define how the product line will win in the market by evaluating customer needs, competitive positioning, and investment priorities • Present strategy updates in regular business reviews and track progress on actions and commitments • Partner with Sales and Customer Account Managers to engage customers early, influence future opportunities, and represent the product line through industry events, technical discussions, presentations, and demonstrations • Identify and pursue new business opportunities by shaping solutions that address customer needs, developing competitive win strategies, and supporting pricing and gate review activities • Lead cross-functional teams to develop proposals, including coordination with engineering, pricing, contracts, and commercial operations to build compelling, executable offers • Lead product execution for assigned programs, serving as a key customer interface and driving alignment across the integrated product team • Own investment planning for the product line, including IR&D projects, and partner with engineering to prioritize development efforts based on strategic roadmap needs and near-term business opportunities • Identify and pursue external funding opportunities, including early customer engagement, proof-of-concept activities, and technology validation efforts • Build and manage external partnerships that strengthen the product portfolio, close capability gaps, and inform make/buy decisions • Serve as a market intelligence leader for the product line by monitoring industry trends, customer needs, and competitive activity • Coordinate with program and sales teams to review, maintain, and validate the product opportunity pipeline • Own product line marketing content, including presentation materials, website content, and other standard collateral • Partner with application engineering to support intellectual property strategy, including patent reviews in key technology areas • Manage product line financial performance, including validation of actual results and support for forecasting • Provide regular updates to leadership on product line performance, risks, opportunities, and execution progress • Operate with strong planning, clear accountability, and disciplined business processes consistent with GE Aerospace’s operating principles for continuous improvement, execution rigor, and customer focus • Apply GE Aerospace’s FLIGHT DECK principles in day-to-day work, using lean execution, continuous improvement, and customer focus to drive results. jobs.description: Excited to grow your career? We value our talented employees, and whenever possible strive to help one of our associates grow professionally before recruiting new talent to our open positions. If you think the open position you see is right for you, we encourage you to apply! Our people make all the difference in our success. The Senior Product Manager Advisor, Agent Experience helps plan and build tools for customer service teams. These tools help agents and operations teams work faster and provide better service. You will work with Engineering, Design, Data Science, Customer Operations, and business partners. Together, you will build tools that are easy to use and can grow with the business. You should understand product management, agent work, and how to solve hard business problems. Responsibilities: Product Strategy and Vision Work with leaders to set the long-term plan for Agent Experience products. Find ways to help agents work better, feel supported, and provide quality service. Turn company and team goals into clear product results. Build business cases and choose work based on customer needs, business value, and company goals. Learning About Customer Needs Talk with agents, team leads, managers, and customers to learn what they need. Review work steps, service paths, and results to find ways to improve. Use feedback and data to test ideas and make choices. Keep up with trends in artificial intelligence (AI) and customer service tools. Building and Launching Products Lead teams as they research, plan, build, launch, and improve products. Write clear product needs, user stories, goals, and rules for when work is complete. Work with Design to make tools simple, useful, and easy to access. Work with Engineering to make sure products can be built, can grow, and stay on schedule. Plan product launches and help teams learn and use new tools. AI and Automation Experience Plan and build AI tools that help agents do their work. These may include agent copilots, suggested answers, case summaries, smart routing, and automatic work steps. Make sure AI tools improve work while staying clear, trusted, and accurate. Use feedback and testing to improve how the AI tools work. Data and Results Set clear goals and measures for agent work, service quality, and team results. Track how products work and test changes to make them better. Build dashboards and reports that show business results. Use data to choose updates and confirm that changes work. Working with Partners Build good working relationships with Operations, Customer Experience, Engineering, Design, Analytics, and leaders. Clearly share the product plan, progress, risks, and new ideas. Use facts and data to help leaders set company goals. Qualifications: Required At least 5 years of product management experience. 2 Years of leading complex internal platforms, enterprise products or operational tooling. Experience with internal systems, business products, or tools used by operations teams. Ability to take a product from an idea to launch and then improve it. Experience in customer support, a contact center, service operations, or workforce management. Ability to use data to make product choices. Clear speaking, writing, planning, and partner management skills. Experience working on an agile product team. Bachelor's degree or equal hands-on experience. Preferred Experience building products that use AI, machine learning, or generative AI. Experience with customer relationship management systems, ticketing tools, or customer service platforms. Knowledge of agent work measures, operations goals, and service steps. Experience testing product ideas and using product data tools. Master's degree in business or a related field. If you will be working at home occasionally or permanently, the internet connection must be obtained through a cable broadband or fiber optic internet service provider with speeds of at least 10Mbps download/5Mbps upload.
